subject: prd/workbench-ui
statement: Where a document is presented, the reading room should expose its exact repository path and tracked reference for use in the operator conversation, while itself performing no comment capture, edit, or write.
rationale: "interact" means carrying precise context to the flow that owns review
fit_criterion: demo on a live doc: the hand-off supplies the exact path and reference without retyping; a write-audit of the UI process across the demo shows zero repo writes
